notes.title: Open World Update
notes.content:
[b]Open World + Weather Update[/b]
Welcoming all new trees, bushes, ferns, rocks, rivers, and more now generating in the world of Igrerea. Also a new weather system including many weather types, generating clouds, rain, day/night, thunder, and region based weather. Below you can see images of some of these weather types and forestry in the mountains of Igrerea..

notes.title: Open World Update
notes.content:
The first three regions of Igrerea consisting of "The Starting Plains", "Low-Level Forest", and "The Mountains" have been sculpted and are being populated with trees and resources. Other regions will be added and revealed as progress moves along.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326473/2645bf2632ee0243a1d08d0620b40dac5ae9144e.png[/img]
Many more updates to come and you can learn more in our discord https://discord.gg/Gfw3yTTHV2

Thank you to everyone who wishlisted the game, each one of you hold a deep place in our hearts and am glad you want to stick with us through this adventure!
